change: The man is crouched beside a white toilet with the seat up, running his index finger along the grey-brown band on the inside of the dry bowl, looking closely at where his finger is going. Small bathroom, white tile, daylight from a window on the left.
motion: he moves his finger a few centimetres further along the band and keeps his eyes on it
causality: his fingertip stays close to the porcelain and the band itself does not change

change: The man is crouched low beside a white toilet holding a small work light up under the rim of the bowl with one hand, his face beside it looking in at the lit underside. The seat is up. Small bathroom, tiled floor.
motion: he holds the light steady under the rim and tilts his head a little to see further in
causality: the light stays in the same position under the rim for the whole take

change: The man is standing over a white toilet with his fingers hooked under both edges of the porcelain tank lid, taking the weight of it, looking down at his hands. Small bathroom, white tile, daylight from the left.
motion: his fingers tighten under the edges of the lid and the lid rises a couple of centimetres
causality: the lid stays flat and level and rises only as much as his hands do

change: The man is leaning over the open tank of a white toilet with the lid already off, looking straight down into the water inside, the top of his head and his shoulders filling the upper part of the frame. Small bathroom, white tile.
motion: he leans a little further over the open tank and turns his head slowly from one side to the other

change: The man is crouched at the side of an open toilet tank pointing his index finger down at a dark stained bolt head in the bottom corner of the tank, his face visible above the rim of the tank. Small bathroom, overhead light.
motion: he moves his pointing finger across to the second bolt head in the far corner
causality: only his finger moves and the tank and its fittings stay exactly where they are

change: The man is leaning over an open toilet tank with two fingers pinching the edge of the black rubber flapper at the bottom, his face above looking down at it, the brass chain hanging slack beside his wrist. Small bathroom, overhead light.
motion: he lifts the edge of the flapper a couple of centimetres and lets it settle back down flat
causality: only the edge he is pinching lifts and the rest of the flapper stays seated in its opening

change: The man is crouched beside an open white toilet, one hand pointing down into the dry bowl, talking toward the camera with a direct look. Small bathroom, white tile, daylight from a window on the left.
motion: he keeps talking and moves the pointing hand slightly, then rests it on the rim

change: The man is leaning in close over a dry white toilet bowl with both hands on the rim, watching a band of white foam on the porcelain from a few inches away, eyebrows slightly raised. Small bathroom, tiled floor, overhead light.
motion: he leans a couple of centimetres closer to the foam and blinks, still watching it
